values.note: The township page gives 47 campsites in one place and '43-site campground' in another (CampLife listed 42 on 2026-10-11); tents and RVs up to 31 feet. Picnic table and fire pit at every site.

sites.source: https://www.drummondislandtownship.org/campground ('The park features 47 campsites, accommodating both RVs and tents'; 'The 43-site campground accommodates both tents and RVs up to 31 feet'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Outhouses (pit toilets) and two freshwater spigots for drinking water.

facilities.source: https://www.drummondislandtownship.org/campground ('Outhouses & two fresh water spigots'; 'Pit toilets'; 'Two freshwater spigots for drinking water'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Online reservations through the township's CampLife page ('Reserve a Campsite'). 3-night minimum over Memorial Day, the Fourth of July and Labor Day. Cancellation: 25% forfeited 14-21 days out, 50% at 7-14 days, all of it inside 7 days (plus $15 inside 24 hours).

booking.source: https://www.drummondislandtownship.org/campground ('Online Reservations Now Available Reserve a Campsite' -> camplife.com/1378/reservation/step1; 'Minimum Stay - A 3-night minimum stay is required for holidays: Memorial Day ..., Fourth of July ..., Labor Day'; cancellation schedule), read 2026-10-25

note: Drummond Island Township campground 5 miles east of the ferry dock on M-134: turn at the Township Park sign down a gravel road. In a residential area, with direct access to the Drummond Island Heritage Trail; groceries and restaurants within a couple of miles. Cell service is patchy on the route, so note the directions and contact numbers before arriving. --Claude
summary: Township campground page: season May 1 - Oct 31 (new), 47 sites (also '43' on the same page) for RVs to 31 ft (confirmed), electric at half the sites (30 A per CampLife, new), no water at sites (confirmed), pit toilets + two spigots (confirmed), online booking on CampLife (platform/url new) with a 3-night holiday minimum (new). Fees left: the page posts no rate; the stored $28.84 is a CampLife quote of 2026-10-11 (no resident/non-resident split shown). Phone missing (flag). Note trimmed of field restatements.
